title: Nonnegativity of candidate expectation
statement: For a finite candidate set, a default value, and a real-valued function on the candidate domain, if the function is nonnegative at every candidate and at the default value, then its finite candidate expectation is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: The value function is nonnegative everywhere, including at the default
